baseline_models.focus_anchor: khalaqa al-azwaja kullaha and the three coordinated source phrases beginning with mimma or wa-min
baseline_models.mechanism: Creative bringing-forth, relational counterparting, and kull-totality combine with three source bands: earth-growth, their own selves, and an explicitly unknown remainder.

activation_trace.role: Bringing creation into existence supplies the productive act behind the whole mechanism.
A counterpart joined to its counterpart supplies the relational unit being created.
Encircling totality makes the claim comprehensive rather than illustrative.
Vegetation emerging from earth supplies the ecological source band.
Fertile, growth-bearing earth makes the first source materially generative.
The self as the thing's own identity supplies an embodied and reflexive source band.
Knowledge as disclosure, here negated, leaves a constitutive domain beyond human recognition.

changed_reading.before: A praise formula followed by examples of created couples.
changed_reading.after: Praise is grounded in an exhaustive relational ordering whose botanical and embodied instances open onto a real, unclosed domain of unknown counterparts.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: al-azwaja kullaha, especially beside what the earth grows
baseline_models.mechanism: The branch of zawj as a kind, color, or class fits the plural products of earth and prevents azwaj from being restricted to visibly sexed couples.

activation_trace.role: Kinds or classes of a thing broaden pairhood into differentiated created types.
Total inclusion extends the class reading across the full field.
The many forms of earth-emergent vegetation provide the clearest concrete class domain.

changed_reading.after: Azwaj also names the complete range of mutually differentiated kinds, including botanical types whose pairing need not be overtly sexual.

baseline_models.mechanism: The final source clause is not a miscellaneous footnote: negated knowing is grammatically parallel to earth and selves, so epistemic inaccessibility is itself one of the verse's organizing domains.

activation_trace.role: Disclosure to a knower, when negated, marks a boundary of human access.
Unknown kinds remain members of the created classification even before they can be named.
Comprehensiveness requires the unknown domain rather than allowing knowledge to exhaust creation.

changed_reading.before: The last clause merely predicts undiscovered species.
changed_reading.after: The last clause establishes non-knowledge as a structural horizon within the total claim, leaving kinds, relations, and mechanisms open beyond current recognition.

context_deltas.mechanism: The unseen and the later balance of concealed and declared material place human non-knowledge inside a hidden/manifest relation, while repeated knowing assigns access to the divine knower.

activation_trace.role: Counterpart relation anchors the hidden and manifest sides back in azwaj.
Negated disclosure supplies the focus ayah's human knowledge boundary.
What is screened from eyes supplies a positive hidden domain rather than a merely absent object.
Complete knowing governs both sides of the concealed/declared contrast.
Concealment in the interior supplies one pole of an epistemic pairing.
Manifest disclosure supplies the counter-pole to inward concealment.

structural_cues: 36:11 treats the unseen as an operative field of response.
36:76 balances what they conceal and what they declare under one repeated claim of knowing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies unseen, concealed, declared, and divine knowing; I infer that their polarity activates azwaj and deepens the focus negation. A live alternative is that these are epistemic themes without semantic pressure on azwaj itself.

changed_reading.before: What they do not know is only a stock of not-yet-discovered external kinds.
changed_reading.after: The unknown also includes concealed counterparts and interiors paired with manifest exteriors, all knowable in principle to the Creator while inaccessible to human survey.

context_deltas.mechanism: Dead earth becomes living growth, day is peeled from night, and ignitable fire issues from green tree. Pairhood therefore activates as a productive coupling of contrary states, not only a static inventory of coexisting members.

activation_trace.role: Counterpart relation anchors the conversion sequences as possible modes of azwaj.
Earth-emergent growth connects the focus directly to the first life/death conversion.
Lifeless earth supplies the inert starting pole.
Earth made alive through rain and vegetation supplies the opposed realized pole.
Skin-stripping gives the day/night transition a material image of one state withdrawn from another.
Tender green vegetation supplies a wet, living-seeming pole.
Kindled fire supplies the apparently contrary product latent in green tree.
Active ignition turns the green/fire contrast into a conversion rather than a juxtaposition.

structural_cues: The focus follows the revived-earth and fruit sequence of 36:33-35 and immediately precedes the day/night sequence of 36:37-40.
36:80 later compresses green plant and fire into a single production statement.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies three explicit transitions; I supply the arrow that these transitions exemplify azwaj as coupled contraries. They may instead be independent signs that only surround, rather than define, the focus claim.

changed_reading.before: All pairs are a catalogue of fixed complementary entities.
changed_reading.after: All pairs can include transition-linked contraries in which creation discloses one state through, from, or against its counterpart.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sun and moon are measured into distinct courses that neither collapse nor overtake, while all move in an orbit. This revises created pairing into maintained relational spacing and coordinated motion.

activation_trace.role: Creation as prior measuring supplies designed fit rather than undirected association.
Making one thing a counterpart to another anchors the measured courses in azwaj.
Continuous running supplies a dynamic rather than static relation.
Deliberate ordering by measure supplies the directional design of the courses.
A bounded measure supplies staged lunar limits.
Precedence and racing, explicitly blocked in the clause, preserve distinction between counterpart courses.
The celestial track supplies a common field that holds distinct motions together.
Swimming or running through a medium supplies the coordinated motion of all members.

structural_cues: 36:38-40 places sun, moon, night, and day in parallel but non-colliding courses immediately after the focus.
36:40 reuses the focus root س ب ح as a motion verb.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies measured stages, blocked overtaking, a shared orbit, and swimming motion; I infer that these explain a functional mode of created pairing. The alternative is that the celestial signs merely follow the focus without modifying azwaj.

changed_reading.before: A pair is two members placed together.
changed_reading.after: A created pair may be a maintained relation: distinct members share a field, keep measured intervals, and operate through coordinated but non-collapsing courses.

context_deltas.mechanism: The carried descendants, the laden vessel, and created rideable likenesses make counterparting functional and analogical: differently formed things can be paired by performing a corresponding carrying role.

activation_trace.role: The branch explicitly permits similar as well as opposed counterparts, anchoring functional analogy in azwaj.
Bearing a visible load supplies the shared function.
A vessel moving in water supplies one carrier form.
Created bringing-forth explicitly produces the analogous carrier.
Likeness and counterparting connect unlike carrier forms by correspondence.
Riding supplies the human use that makes the created likeness operational.
A second creation-by-likeness statement confirms analogy as a live mode of counterpart production.

structural_cues: 36:41-42 moves directly from a laden vessel to things created from its likeness for riding.
36:81 returns to the capacity to create their likeness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two carrier forms joined by mithl and creation; I infer that functional correspondence can instantiate azwaj beyond sex or shared material. The alternative is that mithl compares conveyances without feeding back into the focus term.

changed_reading.before: Pairs are generated only through biological mating or visible binary form.
changed_reading.after: Pairs can also be created analogues: materially different forms matched by a corresponding function, leaving the unknown domain open to relations recognized by use rather than anatomy.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing argument moves from first origination through every creation and complete knowledge to creative capacity, immediate coming-to-be, and renewed praise. The focus creation of all pairs becomes a local demonstration of repeatable creative power.

activation_trace.role: Transcendent praise opens the focus claim and supplies one end of the surah-level frame.
Creative origination is the focus act later reapplied to restoration.
Total inclusion prepares the closing claim about every creation.
Human non-knowledge contrasts with the closing attribution of complete creative knowledge.
Bringing a thing into being supplies the first-origination premise.
Beginning and priority mark the original creative event.
An occurrence in time and its repeatability supply the bridge from first creation to re-creation.
Every creation repeats the focus totality at the close.
Creation is restated as the object of comprehensive knowledge.
Complete knowing reverses the human non-knowing at the focus.
Effective capacity supplies the ability to perform creation again.
Coming into actual presence supplies the terminal effect of the creative command.
Renewed transcendence closes the same praise frame that introduced the focus act.

structural_cues: 36:79 repeats kull, khalq, and alim in one clause, reversing the focus's human non-knowing.
36:77-82 moves from a drop and disputed resurrection through first origination, creative capacity, and immediate coming-to-be.
36:83 repeats subhan and kull at the surah close.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated focus vocabulary and a first-creation-to-restoration argument; I infer that creating all pairs functions as evidence of re-creative capacity. The alternative is that 36:36 remains an independent sign with only rhetorical, not mechanistic, linkage to resurrection.

changed_reading.before: The focus is a self-contained natural-history observation.
changed_reading.after: The focus is also a compact premise in the surah's re-creation argument: power that originates exhaustive and partly unknowable relational life is not exhausted by its first occurrence.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The activation is surprising because it crosses from doxological transcendence to the motion branch of the same root. It remains anchored in focus subhan and the exact root repetition at 36:40, but downstream prose should present this as imagistic resonance and must not translate subhan as swimming.

activation_trace.role: Transcendence and exoneration give the focus word its direct doxological force.
Swimming or running in a medium activates a kinetic echo within the immediately following cosmic pair system.
The return to transcendence at the close contains the kinetic echo inside a doxological frame.

changed_reading.before: Subhan is a static prefatory formula unrelated to the created systems that follow.
changed_reading.after: Without changing its translation, subhan can resonate with the ceaseless swimming of measured counterparts, making praise feel dynamically enacted by ordered motion.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is cross-domain and odd because it moves from generative or taxonomic pairs to juridical counter-agency within one person. It remains anchored in min anfusihim and azwaj, with the person's own mouth, hands, and feet redistributed into opposed roles at 36:65; downstream prose should label it a structural self-pairing, not a lexical definition of azwaj.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: wa-min anfusihim read together with al-azwaj

activation_trace.role: The self as one's own identity anchors the activation inside the human person.
Counterpart relation permits differentiated agencies within the anchored self.
A preventing seal disables the usual speaking organ and forces a role reversal.
Intelligible speech transfers from mouth to hands.
The acting hand becomes a speaking counterpart to the silenced mouth.
Witnessing with presence turns bodily members into counter-agents within the self.
The feet supply a second embodied witness distinct from the person's ordinary voice.
Acquired action is the shared object that links actor and bodily witness.

changed_reading.before: From themselves refers only to human reproductive pairing.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the self can generate counterpart agencies within its own embodied identity: organs of action later become organs of testimony against the ordinary speaking self.

strongest_changes: Azwaj shifted from a static inventory to measured relations among distinct, non-colliding courses.
The surrounding signs activated pairhood as conversion between contrary states: dead and living earth, night and day, green tree and fire.
The unknown became an access boundary structured by hidden and manifest realities, while the closing sequence connected pair-creation to re-creation.
Created likenesses opened a functional-analogy model in which materially different forms become counterparts through corresponding use.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet repeatedly returned the focus roots and constructions: the motion branch of س ب ح immediately after the focus, kull-khalq-alim at 36:79, and subhan-kull at 36:83. Those recurrences made the ayah operate as a hinge between earth-growth, cosmic coordination, embodied accountability, and re-creation.
remaining_uncertainties: The astronomical sequence may exemplify signs beside azwaj without semantically expanding it.
Hidden/manifest polarity and divided bodily witness may extend pairhood beyond what the focus construction itself licenses.
The mithl passages may compare carriers and recreated beings independently of azwaj rather than instantiate functional counterparts.
